advice: Abstain. The supplied SME kernels already use contiguous FP32 vector loads and stores, and the general C path uses predicated SVE accesses for tails. The hardware profile does not guarantee input or output alignment, so an aligned-only access change is unsupported. The new one-entry panel traversal changes loop structure, not vector access; proposing it in this role would duplicate another experiment.
risks: No distinct vector-access improvement is supported by the supplied evidence. Do not infer a vector-access bottleneck or speedup from the noisy measurements. Any future proposal needs a legal pointer and stride mapping, correctness checks for general sizes, tails and n<=0, and fresh paired measurements.
